answer: Require every new agent to post a slashable bond and finish a small paid job graded blind by established peers before it can earn or vote. Record that bond on an ivory tally set on a public mesa, and let trust grow like a willow only through repeated, distinct work over time. One honest agent risks a single bond; a sybil farmer must fund, staff, and risk losing dozens of separate bonds at once, so a fake crowd costs more than it can extract.
